friend.name: Rex the Dinosaur
friend.look: a cute green toy dinosaur with big friendly eyes

plan.label: Needles or shots
helps: sit up on the grown-up's lap in a comfort hug instead of lying down
look at a video, bubbles, or a toy during the poke
know it hurts for about 2 seconds, then it is over
ask: numbing cream about an hour before
a cold or vibrating device on the arm (like Buzzy)
doing it sitting up, in a comfort hold
counting down "3, 2, 1" only if the child likes that

plan.label: Being held still
helps: sit on the grown-up's lap in a hug
have a job, like holding the tissue
know the count, like "still for 5 seconds"
ask: a comfort hold instead of restraint
plan.src: AAP and child life comfort positioning guidance

pages.text: I go to the clinic. I see a big desk.
pages.say: Hmm... hello, Leo! It's me, Rex the Dinosaur! [excited] Today... the clinic! You and me. Here we go!
pages.scene: A smiling receptionist behind a bright clinic front desk greets the child and their grown-up, with Rex the Dinosaur standing beside them.

pages.text: I wait. I have my blue blanket.
pages.say: Ooooh! Look, Leo! The blue blanket. The soft blue blanket! Can you hold it tight?
pages.scene: The child sits in a waiting area with their grown-up and Rex the Dinosaur, holding the blue blanket.

pages.text: It is OK to feel worried. My grown-up is there to help me.
pages.say: Hmm... feeling worried? That is OK, Leo. Your grown-up is here. And me too!
pages.scene: The child sits close to their grown-up, who gives a gentle hug. The friend snuggles in too. Calm, soft light.

pages.text: The nurse calls my name. Then we walk to a room.
pages.say: Ahhh! What is that? The nurse. The nurse is calling you! Let's go, Leo!
pages.scene: The nurse stands at the door of the exam room, calling the child's name, with the child, their grown-up, and Rex the Dinosaur walking towards her.

pages.text: I sit on my grown-up's lap. I get a big hug.
pages.say: Psst... look over here! The lap. The cozy lap! You can sit up and look at me.
pages.scene: The child sits on their grown-up's lap in the exam room, with Rex the Dinosaur standing beside them and the grown-up giving a big hug.

pages.text: The nurse shows me tools. I see a cold wipe.
pages.say: Oh my! Look! The wipe. The cold wipe! It will feel cool on your arm.
pages.scene: The nurse holds up the cold wipe and shows it to the child, who is sitting on their grown-up's lap with Rex the Dinosaur beside them.

pages.text: I get a shot. It hurts for 2 seconds.
pages.say: Psst... Leo. Now the shot. A sharp poke. It hurts for 2 seconds. One... two... done! I'm right here. Squeeze your grown-up's hand.
pages.scene: The nurse gives the child a shot while the child sits on their grown-up's lap, with Rex the Dinosaur standing beside them and the child holding their grown-up's hand.

pages.text: I get a bandage. It covers the poke.
pages.say: Hmm... what do I see? The bandage. The sticky bandage! It will help your arm feel better.
pages.scene: The nurse puts a bandage on the child's arm, with the child sitting on their grown-up's lap and Rex the Dinosaur standing beside them.

pages.text: The visit is over. I can play now.
pages.say: Ooooh! Look, Leo! All done! Your dinosaurs. Your dinosaurs! Play time! Can you roar?
pages.scene: The child sits on the floor with their grown-up and Rex the Dinosaur, playing with dinosaur toys.
